name: tabctl
description: CLI tool to manage and analyze browser tabs

scripts.build: node scripts/gen-version.js && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-artifacts.js && node scripts/bundle-extension.js && cargo build --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --workspace
scripts.rust:verify: cargo fmt --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --all -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && npm run rust:test
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run rust:verify
scripts.test:integration: cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --test browser_integration --test browser_coverage --test browser_primitives --test local_commands -- --ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1
scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
